name: SAM and HD domain containing deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase 1
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: SAMHD1 encodes deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase SAMHD1. Annotated molecular activities include dGTPase activity and RNA nuclease activity. It participates in double-strand break repair via homologous recombination and immune response.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include SAMHD1-related type 1 interferonopathy (autosomal recessive); Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 5 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Plasma Cell Myeloma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
